title: Model theory of class-sized logics
summary: We study compactness and Löwenheim-Skolem properties of fragments of the class-sized logic $\mathcal{L}_{\infty \infty}$ and of class-sized versions of second-order and sort logics. In these fragments, certain combinations of infinitary quantifiers and boolean connectives are banned. While model-theoretic properties fail for unrestricted class logics, this drastically changes in our more restricted setting.
